kanjiDisposition.reason: Actual labels and full raw meanings identify a connective/possessive, zodiac/time, bookmark/guidebook, boar and jasmine. None means strong or taut.

Achievement/merit, censure/impeachment/investigation and cutting/dividing are not strength or tautness. All THREE curated distractors are N1 and available in actual default N1/All/custom pools. Original failing test-only membership assertion is preserved, not rebranded as a production/source defect.

Raw endure/keep out/stave off/tide over/defy/slight/surpass senses were all inspected. Enduring or surpassing may involve strength but names a different relation/action; actual endure; surpass is not an alternative translation of strong; taut.
Strong in the full raw character record, with taut/stretching qualification in the committed actual Daijisen entry. Four declared direct guards remain unchanged.

wordDisposition.reason: All applicable complete families and actual bodies were inspected. Vulgarity, inconvenience/pity, wrongdoing, separateness, reprimand, quotation, a bullet/counter, malice, abundance, humility, luxury and a mythical bird do not name vigorous artistic/prose style. Secondary senses include humorous or expanded uses and spelling-specific identity: 不便ふびん is a separate rare spelling of pitiful, and 弾たま is the actual bullet article, not counterだん. Neither creates target ambiguity.

A masterpiece or humorous absurdity and exceptional/special/especially evaluate quality or exceptionalness, not a work's force or vigor. A vigorous work need not be outstanding; the target body explicitly makes this distinction. Full secondary senses and actual labels were inspected.

Creative production, authoring, calligraphy and painting identify an activity, field or work/medium rather than its vigorous style. Related art/writing tags do not establish substitutable answers. Both meaning directions retain these distinctions.

Pushy/coercive action and violent/rough/reckless behavior are not the style-qualified vigorous target. Forcefulness can coexist with coercion or roughness, but does not itself imply either. All rough-language/unreasonable-demand/wild-argument and assault senses were inspected rather than relying solely on physical violence or positive versus negative evaluation.
Complete1839950 vigorous/powerful plus actual Daijisen 力強いこと/書画・詩文など/雄勁な筆跡 support the art/prose-qualified label. Six declared direct word guards remain unchanged; no inferred vocabulary level.

additionalHypotheses.evidence: Actual noun article and complete1208270 cover energy/vigor/liveliness/spirit/life/animation, while1839950 and actual Daijisen support the target's forceful expression. Shared vigor alone does not establish that liveliness is the displayed style-qualified target, or that the target names an energetic atmosphere.
additionalHypotheses.limits: Not an absolute atmosphere-only semantic boundary or a universal ban on lively art. Original810 withdrawn low-confidence concern remains preserved.
additionalHypotheses.mechanics: 64 explicit unguarded pair-pool samples across both target orientations and meaning directions preserve actual availability.
